conviction_note: The issuer confirms the H1 2026/27 report comes after the Warsaw close on Wed 25 Nov, so the reaction lands on 26 Nov and the sealed bmo window (close 24 to close 25) holds no release. I estimate the move at 6.5% from the name's own observed print reactions (7.7%, 8.4%, 4.5%, 2.3% and 12.7% on the last five releases), the Q2 P&L being new and an Oct-Nov MRR comment being likely. p_up is 48: an FX tailwind on Q2 PLN revenue and an expected interim dividend are offset by the post-price-hike MRR decline and a history of prints being sold. The findings net to +0.1 and the scaled number is -0.26; both are close to zero because I have no sourced number the market has not seen.

already_public.what: Q2 2026/27 KPIs (szacunkowe): MRR USD 7.29m at 30 Sep (+3.3% y/y, -2.3% q/q), ARR USD 87.48m, payments received USD 23.61m (+6.2% y/y, -2.4% q/q), API usage fees >USD 450k

Q1 2026/27 full report: revenue PLN 83.2m (USD 22.61m), net profit PLN 29.1m, record deferred revenue PLN 77.2m from the end of LiveChat price grandfathering; the company flagged that July-August MRR was falling q/q
Report date and time: H1 2026/27 report on Wed 25 Nov after the WSE close, no conference call, webinars in early January after the Q3 KPIs

new_in_release.expect: Q2 PLN P&L, not pre-released. Revenue is probably up q/q and y/y in PLN: USD revenue of roughly 22.6-23.3m from deferred-revenue release, with USD/PLN averaging 3.757 in Jul-Sep against 3.654 in Apr-Jun. Mildly positive.
Likely a comment on Oct-Nov MRR. The Q1 release carried the July-August warning and the stock fell 12.7%. Direction unknown; this is the line that sets the size of the move.
Probably an interim dividend proposal: last year's H1 release proposed 1.15 zl. A similar one, about 3% of spot, is expected; skipping it would be negative.
Text gives no formal guidance; the only target is the ARR goal of USD 100m. No change expected.

bar: unsourced: I found no PAP or other consensus for Q2 or H1 2026/27. For reference, Q1 2026/27 PAP consensus net profit was PLN 32.5m against PLN 29.1m actual (https://www.parkiet.com/technologie/art45074851-analitycy-ciemnozolta-lampka-ostrzegawcza-dla-text). Every finding is capped small.
session_check: amc. The issuer's investor-news item of 24 Nov 2026 says: 'Text plans to publish its report for the first half of the 2026/27 financial year on Wednesday, November 25, after the close of trading on the Warsaw Stock Exchange' (https://text-investor-relations.netlify.app/news/publication-of-results-for-the-first-half-of-the-2026-27-financial-year). The last print was also after the close: Q1 published 2026-08-28 18:52 (https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/150394,text-podnosi-mrr-po-zmianie-cennikow-i-szykuje-ekspansje-ai), with the gap on 31 Aug. The reaction window is therefore close 25 Nov to close 26 Nov.
positioning_check: Register not covered for this market. The KNF short register is unreadable from this container (403), so short interest is unknown, not zero. priced_lean_pct (+0.40) is just the 20-day run-up (-8.03%), which is also the free control, so it carries no independent positioning signal.

findings.finding: The pre-released Q2 KPIs plus Q3-2026 FX imply Q2 PLN revenue of roughly PLN 85-88m (Q1 83.2m; Q2 2025/26 about 82.8m). That would be the first y/y PLN revenue growth in several quarters: payments USD 23.61m were +6.2% y/y, deferred revenue stood at a record PLN 77.2m at end-June, and USD/PLN averaged 3.757 in Jul-Sep against 3.654 in Apr-Jun and 3.640 a year earlier.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026/27 revenue missed consensus (PLN 83.2m against almost 88m expected) and the stock fell 12.7% on 31 Aug, but that release also carried the MRR warning. H1 2025/26 profit missed and the stock fell 8.4% on 27 Nov 2025.
findings.original_quote: Wysoki udział płatności rocznych przełożył się na wzrost poziomu przychodów przyszłych okresów (rekordowe 77,2 mln zł) [A high share of annual payments lifted deferred revenue to a record PLN 77.2m] -- biznesradar 2026-08-28
findings.why_not_priced: The KPIs and FX are public, so only the PLN translation and the cost line are new. I found no consensus to show whether analysts already carry the FX lift. If it were fully in, Q2 estimates around PLN 87m would be visible; none are published. Sized small because the inputs are pre-released and the bar is unsourced.
findings.independence: FX averages computed from Yahoo PLN=X daily closes (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/PLN=X?range=2y&interval=1d). The deferred-revenue figure comes from the Q1 report summary (https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/150394,text-podnosi-mrr-po-zmianie-cennikow-i-szykuje-ekspansje-ai).

findings.finding: MRR fell 2.3% q/q in Q2 (7.46 to 7.29m USD) after the one-off lift from ending LiveChat price grandfathering in Q1, so the release's likely Oct-Nov operational comment risks another 'MRR still falling' line. The last such comment drove a 12.7% fall. Freshworks' CX ARR growing only 4% y/y (3 Nov 2026) points to a soft SMB customer-service market.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q1 release of 28 Aug 2026 flagged July-August MRR falling q/q; the stock fell 12.66% on 31 Aug, and PKO called it a 'ciemnożółta lampka ostrzegawcza'. The Q1 KPI showing MRR +7.6% q/q was followed by +6.3% on 7 Jul 2026.
findings.original_quote: W tym aspekcie dostrzegamy co najmniej ciemnożółtą lampkę ostrzegawczą [In this respect we see at least a dark-amber warning light] (BM PKO BP on the company's July-August MRR comment)
findings.why_not_priced: Oct-Nov MRR is not public. The stock is down 15.4% over 60 days with no company news, which suggests part of further erosion is already discounted; that is why this is sized near zero despite the wide range. If the market expected a clean MRR rebound, the stock would not sit at its 2026 lows.
findings.independence: Freshworks Q3 2026: CX ARR $404m, +4% y/y (https://www.financialcontent.com/article/gnwcq-2026-11-3-freshworks-reports-record-third-quarter-2026-results). This is a peer proxy, not a counterparty.

findings.finding: Last year's H1 release carried an interim dividend proposal of 1.15 zl, and the policy is to pay out the highest possible share of profit, so a similar advance (about 3% of spot) is the expected part of this release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The H1 2025/26 release with the 1.15 zl advance still fell 8.4% on the profit miss; the dividend did not lift that reaction.
findings.original_quote: Zaliczka na dywidendę: 1,15 zł na akcję (wniosek do Rady Nadzorczej o zgodę na wypłatę) [Interim dividend: 1.15 zl per share (request to the Supervisory Board for approval)]
findings.why_not_priced: The advance is mostly expected. The asymmetry is that omitting or cutting it would be news: cash was PLN 93.9m at end-June and about PLN 54.9m of final dividend was paid on 15 Oct. Sized near zero.
findings.independence: Dividend policy and the 6 Aug AGM payout (https://www.parkiet.com/technologie/art45074851-analitycy-ciemnozolta-lampka-ostrzegawcza-dla-text).

baseline_tension: The findings are roughly neutral (+0.1). The run-up lean (+0.40, from a -8% run-up) argues for mean reversion, and my evidence does not oppose it; but the name's history of selling off on prints keeps p_up just under 50.
language_note: The Polish press (Parkiet, PKO via Parkiet) carried the analyst view that falling MRR matters more than the Q1 miss ('ciemnożółta lampka ostrzegawcza') and the 'no longer a top pick' stance; English sources did not.
Strefa Inwestorów carried last year's H1 numbers with the 1.15 zl interim dividend proposal and the 09:58 publication timestamp; the English sources did not.
Biznesradar (Polish) carried the Q1 report's 18:52 timestamp and the record deferred revenue of PLN 77.2m, which support the amc session and the Q2 revenue arithmetic.
The decisive session fact came from the issuer's English IR page, not from a Polish source.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the Q2 revenue finding rests on pre-released KPIs, so it was cut from +0.5 to +0.3.

'You were right about the number and too small about the move' / 'the move is in the guide': abs_move_pct raised from 6.0 to 6.5 because the Oct-Nov MRR comment is the guide-equivalent and the name's observed print reactions have a 7.7% median; p_up unchanged.
'Your own session check was right three times out of three': session_check opens with amc and cites the issuer's timestamp.
